messages:
Alex Chen: hey team — first week setup question: where should I keep my ramp notes vs official team docs? also who owns the product templates so I can request edit access? @Priya @Sam
Priya Patel: welcome Alex! For canonical docs: Company Wiki (left sidebar) > Docs Library > Teams > Product. Ramp notes are usually kept in your personal workspace or under Product > New Hires if you want them visible to the squad. Templates are under Company Wiki > Templates. Owner is shown in the template header. :)
Sam Ortiz: if you just need a private copy, click ••• -> Duplicate to your workspace. That avoids accidental edits to canonical pages. If you need edit rights on the source template, file the access request (link below) and tag the owner. :thumbsup:
Maya Li: quick tip — we try to keep owner metadata on every template. Open the template and look at the top: Owner: <team/name>. If it's blank, add a comment like "@team-docs can you confirm owner?" and we'll route it.
Alex Chen: thanks — is there a Slack shortcut or one-liner to request edit access instead of filling the form?
Priya Patel: you can do either. From Slack we recommend the request form for audit trail, but there's a quick slash helper if urgent. Example command (paste in devex or #help-docs):
```
/request-docs-edit --page "https://notion.redwood.company/Product/Ramp Notes/Alex Chen" --reason "ramp and 1:1 notes" --notify @Maya
```
That creates a ticket and pings the owner.
DevexBot: Auto-reply: Received access request #DOC-4821 for Alex Chen -> Product/Ramp Notes. Assigned to Product Docs team. ETA: 1 business day.
Alex Chen: filed the request, got the ticket. last ask — are there recommended templates for 1:1s and onboarding goals?
Maya Li: yes — Templates > New Hire Toolkit contains: 1:1 agenda, 30/60/90 goals, ramp checklist, and engineering onboarding playbook. Duplicate and rename (e.g., "Alex Chen — 1:1") then share with your manager. If you want me to add your manager as an editor, ping me here and I can add them. :wave:
